user.title: Set up OggStudio
user.description: Record, import, save and replay patterns on your Ogg devices. Requires Ogg 2.1 or later.

abort.ogg_required: Set up the Ogg integration first.

save.name: Save script
save.description: Save a funscript under a name (overwrites a script with the same name).

script.name: Script
script.description: Funscript object (pos 0-100; optional channels.V1 for motor 2). metadata.type 'stroke' marks a stroke script, converted to vibration when played.

mode.name: Run mode
mode.description: Stroke scripts only: how position becomes vibration. speed, position, combo (speed plus position), down (speed on downstrokes only) or up (upstrokes only).

play.name: Play script
play.description: Play a saved script (or a given script) on an Ogg device.

entity_id.name: Device
entity_id.description: Any Ogg entity of the device.

name.name: Name
name.description: Saved script; defaults to the selected one.

script.name: Script
script.description: Play this funscript without saving it.

mode.name: Run mode
mode.description: Stroke scripts only: how position becomes vibration. speed, position, combo (speed plus position), down (speed on downstrokes only) or up (upstrokes only). Defaults to the mode last used for the script; giving one remembers it.

entity_id.name: Device
entity_id.description: Any Ogg entity of the device.

set_mode.name: Set run mode
set_mode.description: Remember how a saved stroke script is converted to vibration.
